name: Selection toolbar
description: Actions take shape around your selection.
detail: A compact selection count expands into contextual actions. The surface follows the current selection and folds away when it clears.
when: Bulk actions for selected files, messages, or table rows.
integration: Connect count, actions, and onClear to host-owned selection. Each action calls its real onSelect operation; pending and failure follow its promise. The host clears or updates selection after acceptance. Supply returnFocusRef for focused controls that disappear; unrelated focus stays put. Preview archive and restore affect local sample files only. Replay never calls actions.
props: count, actions, onClear, returnFocusRef, ariaLabel, speed, radius, className, style
